claim: Every goal route on apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts (listGoals, createGoal, listGoalsWithProgress, getGoalProgress) hands the token's gate, salesGateFor(user), to GoalsService, and the export's goals cutting in apps/api-gateway/src/reports/exports/report-cutting-reader.service.ts passes EXPORT_READS_SALES (ADR 0298 decision 9: the routes pass the token's gate on goals; report exports pass it open). A goal method given no gate holds it closed, as decision 9 decides, so a route that dropped the argument would withhold an owner's figure once a goal reads the gate.
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys,pathlib; C=pathlib.Path('apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); R=pathlib.Path('apps/api-gateway/src/reports/exports/report-cutting-reader.service.ts').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); M=re.findall(r'this\.goalsService\.(listGoals|createGoal|listGoalsWithProgress|getGoalProgress)\(([^;]*?)\);',C,re.S); bad=sorted(set(n for n,a in M if 'salesGateFor(user)' not in a)|(set(['listGoals','createGoal','listGoalsWithProgress','getGoalProgress'])-set(n for n,a in M))); E=re.findall(r'this\.goals\.listGoalsWithProgress\(([^;]*?)\);',R,re.S); bad+=['export goals cutting'] if len(E)!=1 or 'EXPORT_READS_SALES' not in E[0] else []; print('OPEN: '+', '.join(bad) if bad else 'HOLDS'); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
